name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Wrenna's gold is lower than both the adventurer with the Greataxe and the adventurer with the Warhammer.
The adventurer with the Greataxe's gold is exactly 30 gp more than Lyra.
Between Quarterstaff and Warhammer, one goes with Wrenna and the other with 59 gp.
Either Kael goes with 69 gp or 39 gp goes with Quarterstaff.
If both 59 gp goes with Sable and 69 gp does not go with Quarterstaff, then all of Longsword goes with Lyra, Warhammer does not go with Kael, and Lyra does not go with 39 gp.
49 gp does not go with Greataxe if and only if Dagger goes with 29 gp.
